scope: Trends and qualitative foil response with accepted M13 cell-size controls and one immutable C01 reference per campaign
expanded_mesh_policy: PRE W04: two consecutive stable CLhydro/CD checks below 0.5% in adjacent 0.2 s windows. Until midnight seek original C01 compatibility within 0.5%; from midnight the user permits stable PRE to become the new C01 and requires rerunning W01-W07. Unstable PRE continues settling; physics and stability thresholds remain unchanged.
authority: User 2026-11-03: globally record five complete wave cycles, exclude the first from analysis including earlier waves; evaluate cycles 2–5. All numerical thresholds unchanged.
mesh_review: The existing M10–M13 comparison and accepted M13 support this stage; no repeat mesh study.
Q_definition: Q_CD = mean(CD_wave over complete measured cycles 2–5; cycle 1 excluded) - accepted mean(CD_C01)
negative_Q: Drag reduction in the selected configuration
